**Repaired finding submitted — deviation (critical), § 14.2**

The substance of the redline is unchanged; only the edit anchoring was widened so each operation is measured against full-sentence context rather than a three-word window (the earlier 0.747 ratio was an artefact of the narrow anchor, not of surplus language):

- Op 1 (whole first sentence as anchor): "14.2 **Customer** exclusively owns**, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer,** every Deliverable created for Customer."
- Op 2: "**Vendor** receives a revocable" (was "Customer receives a revocable").

Resulting clause: "14.2 Customer exclusively owns, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer, every Deliverable created for Customer. Vendor receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term."

Scope remains confined to § 14.2 — §§ 14.1, 14.3 and 14.4 already give us Customer Data/IP retention, Vendor Technology retention with the § 13.2 perpetual licence-back, and no joint ownership — and the comment offers the licence-back fallback.
